title: Electric driving and range impressions
summary: This topic centers on electric propulsion and electric range, with clear praise for range and EV driving in some reviews but many fragments that only mention electric configuration without a clear opinion.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle as an excellent electric car and specifically describe the electric range as very good or satisfying.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on dissatisfaction with electric range or confusion around the electric motor and combustion-engine interaction.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly state that the vehicle is electric or discuss electric range context without a clearly expressed evaluation.

limitations: Most topic fragments are undetermined, so the available examples provide limited evidence about clearly expressed sentiment.
The sample fragments mix straightforward EV identity statements with electric-range comments and drivetrain explanations, which limits how specifically the topic can be summarized.
Examples are sentiment-stratified and not a random sample, so they should not be treated as representative of all reviews.
